claims.statement: Doosan Enerbility (2026-03-06): contract with an unnamed U.S. client for seven 380 MW gas turbines, delivering one gas turbine and one generator per month from May 2029 to a data center the client is building; 12 gas turbines now to deliver in the U.S. Supplier self-report; first delivery is more than three years out.

nodes.name: Gas turbine generator set for onsite power

source_doc.permission_basis: Doosan Enerbility 公開新聞稿（斗山集團官網）；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。published_at 取新聞稿日期 2026-03-06。
source_doc.title: Doosan Enerbility 新聞稿（2026-03-06，斗山集團官網）：與美國客戶簽 7 台 380 MW 燃機，2029-05 起每月各交一台燃機與發電機給客戶興建中的資料中心；在美累計 12 台

sources.quote: On March 6th, Doosan Enerbility announced that it had signed a contract with a U.S. client to supply the company with seven units of its 380MW gas turbine.
Starting in May 2029, Doosan is to sequentially deliver gas turbines and generators, one of each per month, to the data center being built by the client.
With this recently won contract, Doosan Enerbility now has a total of 12 gas turbines to deliver in the United States.
